sources: Issue #19, a refactor analysis of bc18fe9, rechecked on this commit.
Findings of the 2026-10-18 analysis run that were verified in the code.

items.label: expected
items.summary: Every withArtifactLock call wraps a withFileLock call on the same path, in 15 places.

items.label: expected
items.summary: callRepositoryTool names the seven analysis tools in a ternary chain and again in an includes list.

items.label: expected
items.summary: callRepositoryTool also dispatches workflow recording, decision recording, session capacity and session usage.

items.label: expected
items.summary: The record_workflow_decision schema repeats value lists that normalizeDecision owns; readability is an exact copy.

items.label: expected
items.summary: isObject, nonemptyString, assertIsoDate, readHookInput and assertExactKeys are copied across session and hook modules.

items.label: acceptable
items.summary: runCodeGraph, runCommand and requestWithAppServer each own timeout, kill and output limits; keeping them distinct is defensible.

items.label: expected
items.summary: The search providers build the same result shape by hand and repeat small helpers.

items.label: expected
items.summary: The Codex adapter capture method is one function of about 350 lines and 82 branches.

items.label: expected
items.summary: The red-checkpoint pass rule is restated with different wording in several skills.

items.label: expected
items.summary: updateRoadmap and updateInitiative run the same locked load, revision check, history and write procedure.

items.label: expected
items.summary: EVENT_TYPE_ORDER hand-lists the event types that SESSION_TRACE_EVENT_TYPES owns.

items.label: expected
items.summary: The activity values are written twice in active-operations.mts.

items.label: expected
items.summary: isInside has three copies; two reject a child named ..foo.

items.label: expected
items.summary: bench.py records Claude cache tokens as 0 and counts Codex cached input twice, unlike skill_eval/run.py.

items.label: acceptable
items.summary: The general resolveArtifactPath lives in the concept-delta module, so other records report concept-delta errors.

items.label: acceptable
items.summary: startReviewApp is the largest complex unit, with 389 lines and 20 nested functions.

items.label: acceptable
items.summary: Some exports have no importers outside their module.

items.label: acceptable
items.summary: requirementLinks and escapeHtml are copied inside the review browser views.

items.label: acceptable
items.summary: The session-trace store writes files with fewer safety checks than the session-facts store.

items.label: acceptable
items.summary: Some workflow concepts are missing from the Common terms section, and a gate-rules pointer resolves to the wrong section.
